headline: SIGN AFTER CHANGES: 3 high-priority blockers regarding exclusivity and uncapped indemnity
nextAction: Karandeep must renegotiate the exclusivity, indemnity, and non-compete clauses with Datavane.

findings.title: Collides with CloudSpan Technologies: Competing Platform exclusivity in India and GCC
findings.impact: Collides with the CloudSpan exclusivity promise, live until August 31, 2028.

Subject to the terms of this Agreement, Datavane appoints Partner, and Partner accepts appointment, as a non-exclusive "Datavane Premier Implementation Partner" for the Territory

Partner shall (a) actively promote the Platform to Prospects in the Territory; (b) register all Prospects in the Partner Portal within five (5) business days of first substantive contact; (c) deliver Partner Services to Datavane Accounts in accordance with Datavane's published implementation methodology; and (d) participate in joint marketing activities as agreed in the annual joint business plan

For Prospects referred by Partner that purchase a Platform subscription without Partner Services, Datavane shall pay Partner a referral fee of eight percent (8%) of first-year net subscription fees actually received by Datavane

Affiliate**" means, in relation to a Party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that Party, where "control" means ownership of more than fifty per cent (50%) of the voting securities or the power to direct management

findings.standard: Mutual: each party covers its own breach and negligence; never the other side's negligence. IP-infringement indemnity for deliverables is normal.

fine: No delay penalties are present in the agreement.
Intellectual property provisions protect AtliQ's background IP and only license marketplace submissions.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with a standard three-year post-termination duration.
The agreement does not impose any insurance requirements on AtliQ.
No set-off clauses are included, which aligns with the playbook.
The agreement does not contain any formal acceptance or cure procedures.

4.1 Partner may submit Referral Registrations for prospective customers. CloudSpan shall accept or reject each Referral Registration within ten (10) business days. 4.2 An accepted Referral Registration shall remain valid for one hundred and eighty (180) days. If the prospect signs a subscription order with CloudSpan within that period, it becomes a Referred Customer.
